note: Meetings capture (integrations/capture_meetings.py): the calendar, the Planner tasks and the Teams meeting transcripts of every member mailbox of the tenant directory, listed through the guarded, paged GET /users, except every excluded person (PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS / PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_FILE; unset or empty, the run refuses before any request) and the mail capture's HR / payroll deny list (directory_scope). Calendar window: a year back to 90 days ahead. An event, task or transcript naming an excluded person is withheld whole (counted, never stored). Read with the admin application (PLX_MEETINGS_GRAPH_CREDENTIALS, default AZURE), GET only. No person, address or object id is named here.
